subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The market became more than a place to shop.”?
options: The library became a place where knowledge moved in two directions, not just from older to younger.
A public space becomes more alive when ordinary people are invited to add something of their own.
It became a place where people learned how to keep living things alive after taking them home.
But it became popular because people learned that a shop does not need many choices to make a good impression.
